description: This file contains the implementation of the SmsAuthenticatorController class, which manages SMS-based two-factor authentication workflows including phone number verification, code sending, and validation within the OrchardCore CMS framework.

classes.name: SmsAuthenticatorController
classes.description: Controller managing SMS-based two-factor authentication, including phone number verification, code sending, and validation.

methods.name: Index
methods.description: Displays the SMS verification page with current phone number and options to change.

methods.name: IndexPost
methods.description: Handles submission of new phone number for verification, sends SMS code.

methods.name: ValidateCode
methods.description: Displays the code validation page for the pending phone number.

methods.name: ValidateCode (POST)
methods.description: Processes the entered verification code, confirms phone number, and enables two-factor authentication.

methods.name: GetBodyAsync
methods.description: Generates SMS message body content based on settings and templates.

methods.name: GetContentAsync
methods.description: Renders the message content with user and code data using Liquid templates.

methods.name: SetPendingPhoneNumberAsync
methods.description: Stores the pending phone number in cache with expiration.

methods.name: GetPendingPhoneNumberAsync
methods.description: Retrieves the pending phone number from cache.

methods.name: GetPhoneChangeCacheKey
methods.description: Generates cache key for storing pending phone number based on username.
